questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

111, 222, 444, ?, 1776, 3552
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : **Multiplied by 2.**

So, the series here is :-

111 × 2 = 222

222 × 2 = 444

444 × 2 = **888**

**888** × 2 = 1776

1776 × 2 = 3552

Hence, **"888"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

8 : 496 :: ? : 204 :: 9 : 711
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : **Cube of 1st number = 2nd number + **(1st number × 2)

So,

 
• 8 : 496

​(8)³ = 496 + (8 × 2)

512 = 496 + 16

512 = 512 (LHS = RHS)

​And,

 
• 9 : 711

​​(9)³ = 711 + (9 × 2)

729 = 711 + 18

729 = 729 (LHS = RHS)

​Similarly,

 
• ? : 204​

​​(x)³ = 204 + (x × 2)

(x)³ = 204 + 2x

Now, using option elimination method on the RHS to find 'x' :

 
• Option - (1) : 5 ⇒ [204 + (2 × 5)] = 214 → Not a cube of any number
 
• Option - (2) : 13 ⇒ [204 + (2 × 13)] = 230 → Not a cube of any number
 
• **Option - (3) : 6 ⇒ [204 + (2 × 6)] = 216 → Cube of 6**
 
• Option - (4) : 5 ⇒ [204 + (2 × 11)] = 206 → Not a cube of any number

Thus, x** = 6**

Hence, **"6"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bears are rabbits.

All rabbits are dogs.

Some dogs are black.

**Conclusions.**

I. Some rabbits are black.

II. Some dogs are bears.

III. All bears are dogs.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f81e3ed4687123bff80c8091c10d7e7d1e6a646f2a69d24b25f08bc383e78aeb.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. Some rabbits are black → Does not follow (As all rabbits are dogs and some dogs are black. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some dogs are bears → **F**ollow (As all bears are rabbits and all rabbits are dogs. So, as whole bears comes in dogs therefore it is definitely true)

III. All bears are dogs → Follow (As all bears are rabbits and all rabbits are dogs. So, as whole bears comes in dogs therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions II and III follow**".

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'GHOST’ is written as 'ONGCB' and 'ABIDE' is written as 'UTMRQ'. How will 'RULES' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

**Opposite Letter - 5**

So,

**'GHOST’ is written as 'ONGCB'**

 
• G = T (opposite) - 5 = O
 
• H = S - 5 = N
 
• O = L - 5 = G
 
• S = H - 5 = C
 
• T = G - 5 = B

​And,

**'ABIDE' is written as 'UTMRQ'**

 
• A = Z (opposite) - 5 = U
 
• B = Y - 5 = T
 
• I = R- 5 = M
 
• D = W - 5 = R
 
• E = V - 5 = Q

 

​Similarly, 

**​****'RULES' is written as :**​

 
• R = I (opposite) - 5 = D
 
• U = F - 5 = A
 
• L = O- 5 = J
 
• E = V - 5 = Q
 
• S = H - 5 = C

 

Hence, "**DAJQC**" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some L are R.

II. Some A are R.

**Conclusion:**

I. All A are L.

II. All R are L.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f54c55799a23d01ebf0d19cb0e9408ff179436268d7a1a3f9a0304b9216d0b07.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All A are L → Does not follow (As some A are R and some L are R. So, as there is no direct relation between A and L therefore it is definitely false)

II. All R are L → Does not follow (As some L are R. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion follows**".
